verdict.rationale: Elastic's marketing page claims an AI SRE ('nightshift') that detects and investigates incidents and delivers evidence-backed root cause, plus natural-language interaction with telemetry. That is a first-party AI capability producing incident findings for responders. However, nothing explicitly documents AI-generated summaries of incidents or of alert context, and the evidence is marketing-level only. missing for 10: explicit AI-generated incident/alert summaries, AI context attached to alerts or Cases, in-depth first-party docs, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated summaries of incidents and alert context for responders

citations.quote: Elastic nightshift AI SRE detects and investigates incidents, delivering evidence-backed root cause.
Interact directly with your telemetry through natural language and resolve problems faster without switching tabs or context.
